note: insert_media is an experimental submodule of Insert. It registers a new Insert type 'media' for the core media_library_widget (hook_insert_widgets -> ['media' => ['media_library_widget']]). Its only persistent state is a per-widget third_party_settings.insert_media on an entity_form_display component, with keys view_modes (map of enabled media view modes; empty => disabled) and default (default view mode, shipped default 'full'). The insert 'styles' are the media entity view modes (hook_insert_styles for type media). No config object, route, or permissions. Medium/hard cases are grounded in a real media entity_reference field on Article using media_library_widget with third_party_settings.insert_media.

evals.prompt: The Drupal insert_media submodule lets editors insert media-library items into a text area. Which field widget must a field use for insert_media to attach to it, and what does the insert 'style' correspond to for media?
evals.expected_output: insert_media registers only the core media_library_widget as an Insert source (hook_insert_widgets => ['media' => ['media_library_widget']]). The selectable insert 'styles' for media are the media entity's view modes, so you pick which view modes are insertable and a default view mode.

evals.prompt: insert_media has no settings page. On a Drupal site, how do I turn it on for a media reference field and where is that choice stored, including the default view mode key?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. On the field's Manage form display set the widget to Media library, open the Insert Media details, tick view modes and a default. It is stored as third_party_settings.insert_media on the form-display component: content.<field>.third_party_settings.insert_media with keys view_modes (map) and default (default view mode, shipped default 'full').

evals.prompt: For the Drupal insert_media submodule, what is the shipped default view mode used when inserting media, and what happens if no view modes are selected in a field's Insert Media settings?
evals.expected_output: The shipped default view mode is 'full' (INSERT_MEDIA_DEFAULT_SETTINGS default). If view_modes is empty, Insert Media is disabled for that field and no insert button/functionality is offered.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a media reference field whose Media library widget has insert_media enabled. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the field's machine name and its default insert view mode.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_insert_media: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its media_library_widget component has third_party_settings.insert_media with view_modes {full, thumbnail} and default = full.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a media reference field field_insert_mtask using the Media library (media_library_widget) widget. Using the insert_media submodule, configure the default form display so this field lets editors insert the referenced media in the 'full' view mode. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_insert_mtask media_library_widget component gets third_party_settings.insert_media.view_modes containing 'full' (e.g. set the component's third_party_settings.insert_media.view_modes = ['full' => 'full'] and save, or tick the 'full' view mode under Insert Media on the widget in Manage form display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a media reference field field_insert_media2 whose Media library widget has insert_media enabled. Inspect the live default form display for Article and report the default media view mode that insert_media will use when inserting from that field.
evals.expected_output: For field_insert_media2 the media_library_widget component's third_party_settings.insert_media has default = thumbnail (and view_modes = {thumbnail}). Read core.entity_form_display.node.article.default content.field_insert_media2.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a media reference field field_insert_mtask2 using the Media library (media_library_widget) widget. Using the insert_media submodule, configure the default form display so this field lets editors insert the referenced media in the 'thumbnail' view mode. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_insert_mtask2 media_library_widget component gets third_party_settings.insert_media.view_modes containing 'thumbnail' (set view_modes = ['thumbnail' => 'thumbnail'] and save, or tick the 'thumbnail' view mode under Insert Media on the widget in Manage form display).
